|game_text=Plays on table. If opponent moves from a location you occupy during your turn, they lose 2 Force. At end of opponent's turn, if you control two battlegrounds (a site and system) and opponent deployed a card with ability and did not initiate a battle, may retrieve 1 Force.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Firepower (V)]]; it is the current text. The image is the Players Committee card image, which prints it.
* '''Original''' ([[Firepower (V)]]): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 12 February 2013)<ref name="cl-1200_1-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VShieldsType), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064820/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VShieldsType.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive); the same text in the captures of 13 December 2012 and 12 February 2013 (the capture of 31 May 2013 shows no text)</ref>: “Plays on table. If opponent moves from a location you occupy during your turn, they lose 2 Force. At end of opponent's turn, if you control two battlegrounds (a site and system) and opponent deployed a card with ability and did not initiate a battle, you may retrieve 1 Force.” The first Virtual Shields printing was not found; this is the earliest known text. No published card image shows it; the image of that page is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VSh-D13-Firepower-original-cardmaker.png]]).
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee Virtual Shields sheet (21 May 2013)<ref name="vshields">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/vshields.pdf#page=2 Players Committee Virtual Shields sheet] (Defensive Shield pages of the Virtual Cards Master List, PDF made 21 May 2013), PDF page 2, slip 9 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016180941/https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/vshields.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive]</ref> dropped “you” (“may retrieve 1 Force”): “Plays on table. If opponent moves from a location you occupy during your turn, they lose 2 Force. At end of opponent's turn, if you control two battlegrounds (a site and system) and opponent deployed a card with ability and did not initiate a battle, may retrieve 1 Force.” The Virtual Cards Master List prints the same text (Dark Side p. 18)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=18, page 18. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=18 Internet Archive]</ref>. The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VSh-D-firepower-pre.gif]]) prints it.
